subject: MAP: hosting + geofence decision — Clinicside deployment preference
messages:
From: Elena Morales <elena.morales@clinicside.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Hale <tom.hale@clinicside.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Clinicside MAP draft + hosting guidance needed

Hi Priya —

Thanks for the call this morning. Attached is our first-pass Mutual Action Plan (MAP) for Clinicside's inference rollout. Two quick asks we want to lock down before we move to procurement:

1) Region/geofence requirement: all production PHI traffic must remain in EU (GDPR + local health regs). We may need on-prem for a small subset of anonymized batch processing.
2) Deployment mode: can you confirm tradeoffs for Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private for our use case (cost, latency, auditability)?

Timeline we're targeting: pilot in mid-July, production by end of September. We need clear mutual action items and deliverables so Legal/Procurement can align their review window.

I've attached the MAP draft and a short list of compliance questions (see page 2). Can you: a) annotate the MAP with your preferred path and required signoffs, and b) confirm whether Dedicated EU capacity can be SSO-integrated with our Okta instance?

Elena
Elena Morales
Head of Engineering, Clinicside
elena.morales@clinicside.com

Attachments: Clinicside_MAP_v1.pdf, Clinicside_compliance_questions.docx

From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Morales <elena.morales@clinicside.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 10:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Clinicside MAP draft + hosting guidance needed

Elena —

Thanks for the MAP and the compliance checklist. Quick summary and proposed MAP annotations below so Legal and Procurement have a concrete path:

High-level recommendation (short):
- We recommend Dedicated in the EU as the primary path for production PHI traffic. It provides predictable throughput, tenant isolation, and we can pin model versions.
- Private (VPC / on-prem bundle) for the small batch processing use case you mentioned — we can provide an on-prem package for batch-only workloads or a VPC-enforced pipeline.
- Hosted (our public API) can be used for non-PHI telemetry and dev/testing to speed iteration, but it should not be used for production PHI per your governance.

Tradeoffs (concise):
- Hosted: fastest onboarding, no infra commitments, cheaper for low-volume dev traffic; limited for PHI unless we add a Dedicated boundary.
- Dedicated (EU): SLA-backed capacity, stronger isolation, Okta SSO via SAML/OIDC + SCIM available, supports SOC2 evidence; monthly commit pricing.
- Private (VPC / on-prem): highest control, required for air-gapped or strict audit control; longer lead time (~6-8 weeks for on-prem packaging + security review).

Proposed MAP changes (mutual action items and dates):
- Redwood: provide Dedicated EU capacity spec + SOW draft by 2027-06-18 (Deliverable).
- Clinicside: confirm acceptance of Dedicated EU path or request Private POC by 2027-06-20 (Decision).
- Redwood + Clinicside: legal and infra questionnaire complete by 2027-06-30 (Milestone).
- Pilot kickoff (Dedicated EU): 2027-07-18 — 4-week pilot window.
- Production target: 2027-09-30.

Attachments: I am attaching our SOC2 Type II, a short hosting options workbook, and an annotated MAP (see attachments). We can also provide a stub SOW and a DocuSign link once you confirm Dedicated as the path.

Note on Okta: Dedicated can be integrated with Okta SAML and SCIM for user provisioning. We'll have Karthik loop in a technical checklist in a follow-up.

Let me know if you'd prefer we flip the default (Private-first) — my read is Dedicated EU + Private POC is the fastest path while satisfying your governance.

Thanks,
Priya
Priya Natarajan
Senior Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
priya_natarajan@redwood.ai

Attachments: Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_2026.pdf, Hosting_options_summary.xlsx, Clinicside_MAP_v1-annotated.pdf

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Clinicside MAP draft + hosting guidance needed

Quick technical notes for the MAP (internal):

- EU Dedicated: we can reserve a GPU pool in eu-west-1 region with strict network ACLs and private peering into Clinicside VPC. Latency should be ~25-40ms depending on model size and batching.
- Okta SSO: SAML + SCIM supported out of the box for Dedicated customers — need Clinicside SAML metadata and a SCIM user mapping table.
- Private on-prem bundle: shipping a containerized runtime and a narrow ingress shim for batch jobs — estimate 6 weeks for packaging, security hardening, and an on-site checklist.
- Data residency: we can enforce EU storage and logs retention policies; audit logs export to their SIEM via our secure forwarder.

Recommended line in MAP: "Primary: Dedicated EU (production PHI); Secondary: Private batch POC (on-prem), Tertiary: Hosted for non-PHI dev/testing."

I'll prepare the technical appendix to include in the annotated MAP by EOD. Marcus — can you add the billing cadence and monthly commit estimate for the Dedicated pool?

Thanks — Karthik

From: Elena Morales <elena.morales@clinicside.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Hale <tom.hale@clinicside.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 09:02:00 +01:00
Subject: Re: Clinicside MAP draft + hosting guidance needed

Priya, Karthik —

This is great and aligns with our internal risk assessment. Clinicside confirms the following:

- Path chosen: Dedicated (EU) for production PHI traffic.
- Private on-prem POC: yes, for anonymized batch workloads; please include the on-prem packaging checklist in the MAP appendix.
- Hosted: allowed only for non-PHI dev testing.

Action items on our side:
- We will route SAML metadata and our Okta SCIM mapping to you by 2027-06-18.
- Legal will review the annotated MAP + SOW and aim to sign off by 2027-06-28.

Please send the SOW and a DocuSign link for the Dedicated capacity commitment (we expect a small monthly commit for the pilot) — once Legal signs the SOW we'll kickoff the pilot on 2027-07-18 as proposed.

Elena

Forwarded-For-Signature: https://app.hellosign.com/s/clinicside-sow-draft
